campaign.name: Crēdo Legal — Competitive v1 (Meta)
campaign.derived_from: Competitive teardown of Freedom Debt Relief (Meta Ad Library page 69869352985, ~96 active ads, analysed 2026-09-08)
campaign.notes: Mimics FDR's creative structure, hooks and devices; all debt-settlement claims replaced with Credo's validation/defense positioning. Consumer-debt ads require Meta CREDIT Special Ad Category.

cta.label: Book Now
cta.note: FDR uses 'Apply Now'; for a law firm 'Book Now' matches the existing Credo Meta build.

compliance.universal_footer:
Prior outcomes don't guarantee similar results.

Crēdo Legal. The choice of a lawyer is an important decision and should not be based solely upon advertisements.
compliance.ai_performer_disclosure: Burned into V1, V2 and V5 (synthetic spokesperson): 'Paid attorney advertising. Not a real client testimonial. Features a synthetic, AI-generated performer, not a real person. Prior outcomes don't guarantee similar results.'
compliance.general_ai_disclosure: Burned into V3, V4, V6: 'Attorney Advertising. Includes AI-generated content. Prior outcomes don't guarantee similar results.'
forbidden_claims: settle for less / reduce what you owe as a product promise
confirm: NY pre-approval of every ad before launch

audio.note: All six ads are lip-synced talking heads: the synthetic performer speaks the scripted line, so there is no VO/lip mismatch anywhere. Every spoken word matches the on-screen captions and is part of the copy Jack reviews. Meta autoplays feed video muted, so all six also read correctly with sound off via the burned-in captions.
audio.verification: Each final MP4 was transcribed back (faster-whisper small) and matched against its script.

cast.note: Ensemble cast for creative representation. Meta's CREDIT Special Ad Category restricts audience TARGETING by demographics; it does not restrict who appears in the creative.

creative_set.per_ad: one static concept (1:1 + 1.91:1) and one video concept (9:16 + 4:5)
creative_set.layout: Statics use a measured block layout with auto-fit: each element renders to a tile of known size and the engine stacks them inside a safe box, shrinking until they fit, so text cannot overflow. Landscape (1.91:1) reflows to two columns rather than cropping the portrait design.
